minutes_text:
POLICE OVERSIGHT COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:00 PM

Charlie Parkin, Chair  Otieno Okatch, Commissioner
Dr. Naida Tushnet, Vice Chair  Gus Orozco, Commissioner
Dr. Tiffany Brown, Commissioner  Michael Soto, Commissioner

  Francine Kerridge, Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 6:17 PM, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Brown, Okatch, Orozco, Parkin, Soto, Tushnet

Also present: Francine Kerridge, Director, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, Anita Lakhani,
Deputy City Attorney, Kyle Smith, City Clerk Specialist.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52522  Recommendation to hold an election for the position of Chair and Vice Chair of the
  Police Oversight Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Orozco, to nominate Commissioner
  Parkin for Chair of the Police Oversight Commission. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Brown, Okatch, Orozco, Parkin, Soto, Tushnet
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, declared the nominations open for
  Chair.

  Commissioner Orozco nominated Commissioner Parkin for Chair of the Police
  Oversight Commission.

  Page 1 of 5
   POLICE OVERSIGHT COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:00 PM

  Commissioner Parkin spoke.

  There being no further nominations, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer,
  declared the nominations for Chair closed.

  Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, declared the nominations open for
  Vice Chair.

  Commissioner Okatch nominated Commissioner Tushnet for Vice Chair of the
  Police Oversight Commission.

  Commissioner Tushnet spoke.

  There being no further nominations, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer,
  declared the nominations for Vice Chair closed.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Okatch, to nominate Commissioner
  Tushnet for Vice Chair of the Police Oversight Commission. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Brown, Okatch, Orozco, Parkin, Soto, Tushnet
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  24-52519  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Ethics Program
  Introduction for City Commissions.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Soto, seconded by Commissioner
  Orozco, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Brown, Okatch, Orozco, Parkin, Soto, Tushnet
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Heather Van Wijk, Ethics Officer, City Manager Department, spoke; and
  provided a PowerPoint presentation.

  Page 2 of 5
   POLICE OVERSIGHT COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 6:00 PM

  Commissioner Tushnet spoke.

  Commissioner Okatch spoke.

  Heather Van Wijk, Ethics Officer, City Manager Department, spoke.

  Francine Kerridge, Director of Police Oversight, spoke.

3.  24-52520  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Brown Act and Roberts
  Rules of Order.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Soto, seconded by Commissioner
  Tushnet, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6  Brown, Okatch, Orozco, Parkin, Soto, Tushnet
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Anita Lakani, Deputy City Attorney, spoke; and provided a PowerPoint
  presentation.

4.  24-52523  Recommendation to discuss future Commission meeting dates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Soto, seconded by Commissioner
  Orozco, to approve recommendation, as amended, to hold the next Police
  Oversight Commission meeting in the Civic Chambers on Wednesday,
  July 10, 2024 at 6:00 PM in the Council Chambers. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Brown, Okatch, Orozco, Parkin, Soto, Tushnet
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Francine Kerridge, Director of Police Oversight, spoke.

Commissioner Parkin spoke.

Francine Kerridge, Director of Police Oversight, spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

At 7:13 PM, there being no objection, Commissioner Parkin declared the meeting adjourned.
